title: Blood glucose levels appear irregularly every 5 or 10 minutes
symptom: After updating Samsung Galaxy S10e to Android 10, blood glucose readings appear irregularly every 5 or 10 minutes instead of every 5 minutes as before.
fix: Turn on Samsung Workarounds in less common options/other misc settings, check Bluetooth Watchdog and G5 Bluetooth Watchdog in Bluetooth settings, and uncheck Close GATT on BLE disconnect.
settings_changed: Close GATT on BLE disconnect → unchecked
evidence_quote: In less common options/other misc settings - You need to turn on Samsung Workarounds. In less common options - Bluetooth settings - check Bluetooth Watchdog and G5 Bluetooth Watchdog. Uncheck Close GATT on BLE disconnect.
